name: segmented-trie-key
hypothesis: Traverse the exact `word|TOKEN` dictionary key as two byte segments, eliminating construction/copying of its contiguous temporary key while preserving the existing trie walk and compressed-tail comparison semantics.

diagnostic.build_request: Apply these exact patches to fresh 185 prototype181 instrumentation. Add diagnostic-only counts for control bytes materialized (`n+6` per eligible direct lookup), candidate materialized bytes (0), trie transitions, and compressed-tail compared bytes; calibrate hit/miss/tail-positive/tail-negative cases before workload runs.

supported: trie transition and tail compare work
output parity, one parsing thread, throughput and peak/steady footprint

unavailable.universal equivalence: Finite workload tests do not certify arbitrary keys; preserve the original key lookup fallback where segmented behavior is unsupported.
